references.text: Eliab, son of Pallu, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Reuben in the earlier census.
Eliab was the father of Dathan and Abiram, who rebelled against Moses along with Korah.
Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, refused to come when Moses called for them during Korah's rebellion.
Dathan and Abiram, descendants of Eliab from the tribe of Reuben, are mentioned in connection with their rebellion and punishment.
Pallu is mentioned as one of the sons of Reuben who went to Egypt with Jacob.
Pallu is mentioned in the genealogy as a son of Reuben.
